name: SAM.gov
hint: A public API key from the Account Details page of your SAM.gov account.

pick.name: search_entities
pick.says: Searches entity registrations by UEI, legal name, CAGE code, state or NAICS code; ten to a page.

extra.name: search_opportunities
extra.description: Searches contract opportunities posted between two dates, at most a year apart.

notes.postedFrom: Required. The first posted date, as MM/dd/yyyy.
notes.postedTo: Required. The last posted date, as MM/dd/yyyy.
notes.limit: Required. Records to return, 1000 at most.
notes.offset: Required. The page to start at, from 0.
notes.ptype: The notice type’s code, e.g. o for a solicitation, k for a combined synopsis.

extra.name: search_contract_awards
extra.description: Searches contract awards (FPDS) by contract number, awardee, fiscal year, agency or NAICS code.
